title: Expandable dev indicator on Week screen clean

waves.title: Week helper alignment and packet-local evidence
waves.goal: Align the existing Week runtime disclosure only where current code or tests drift from the approved helper behavior, then close targeted frontend and packet-local read-only evidence without claiming canonical Today/Week ownership.
verification_commands: corepack pnpm --dir frontend exec jest --runInBand test/app/week-page.test.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Existing Week DEV chip remains compact in collapsed state.
On /week in non-production, tapping the chip expands and collapses a local disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Week render-path labels are derived from existing page states and remain stable for canonical, in_progress, empty, error, auth_gate, and loading branches.
Production and non-Week routes remain inert and visually unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-unchanged Week proof plus a packet-local read-only observability verdict classified as clean or degraded-but-expected.
No backend payload, scoring, explainability, WeekBrief, Day screen, or business-logic changes are introduced.
deferred_work: Any additional diagnostics fields beyond render path, bootstrap result, and current mode.
Any Day or multi-route redesign of the shell badge beyond the bounded / and /week helper entry points.
Any separate wave that intentionally owns canonical Today/Week closeout.
